svg.text: Understand what your AI actually built.
Simple Reviewer 1.2 / A readable Vibe Coding review
What changed? What will users see?
Compare files against a named baseline.
Show files, symbols, and line numbers.
Say what ran and what is unknown.
One clear action at a time.
Recheck affected paths after a fix.
Goals, changes, checks, risks, next steps
Full review and snapshot for rechecking
Overview and full record: render. Detailed explanation only: breakdown.
Status markers describe evidence. Panel fills organize the workflow; this is not a test result.
